items.text: Uannga, ujaloq oqaatsit imuiarpara, illillu akianiit katersorpat.
items.q: Is it clear that the reader gathers up the words themselves?

items.text: – Amir-jan, illusi immissinnut Norouz-imi pilluaqqusaqatigiikkassi, uanga sivisuunngitsumik sinilluarpunga.
items.q: Is it clear she took a short nap while you all greeted the children?

items.text: Isaqquttamiit illumut isernerma, Maman televisioni saanut innarsimavoq. Assai marluk uummiaminut inippai, Mahboubeh-mullu oqarpoq:
items.q: Is it clear Maman lies before the TV with both hands on her stomach?

items.text: Ukiakkut taassuma Maman-imut oqarsimavara sapaatimi tamani ilinniagassiisitanut allanut sanaartitsivimmi peqquppagut.
items.q: Is it clear this was in summer, with extra summer classes?
Is it clear she said she had to leave right away?

items.text: Norouz-ip nerissaataani, taalliaq anaanamut pillugu atuartikkama, Maman-ip nuannaarnermut taarserlugu isumaannaanera pilerpoq.
items.q: Is it clear the poem made Maman anxious instead of happy?
The speaker means about a year ago. Is that what this says?

items.text: – Vwuuuum, Babajaqqu Babajaqqu, illiviaraq annertorluinnaq una pisiaraawiga?
items.q: A toddler asks her dad for a big doll. Does it sound like baby talk?
